tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background on every screen size. Warm off-white, never pure grey.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, navigation bars — anything that sits on bg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: table headers, code blocks, sidebars on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and select edges (3.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions on bg and surface (6.3:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand colour, a calm blue: primary buttons, links, focus rings, selected states. White text on it is 6.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds for selected rows, tags and info notes; accent text on it is 5.8:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and danger.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and mobile bottom sheets (ink at 40%).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface. State only — never decorative.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive buttons and invalid input borders on surface.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero titles on desktop and tablet. Drops to h1 on mobile.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles. Use on mobile in place of display.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text on every screen size. Never below 16px on mobile inputs (avoids zoom on iOS).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, table cells, secondary metadata.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, overlines, badges. Use in ink-muted.

spacing.note: An 8px rhythm with a 4px half-step. Gutters grow with the screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items: label and input, chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet and desktop, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side page padding below 768px.

tokens.name: gutter-tablet
tokens.usage: Side page padding from 768px to 1023px.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Side page padding from 1024px.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on wide screens; centre the container.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tags, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs. Bottom sheets on mobile round the top corners only.

shadow.note: Borders first; a shadow only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and mobile bottom sheets. Cards stay flat with a border.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first: write the base styles for phones, then add min-width queries.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: @media (min-width: 768px) — tablet portrait and up.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: @media (min-width: 1024px) — tablet landscape, laptop and up.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: @media (min-width: 1280px) — the container stops growing at container-max.

grid.note: Column count per breakpoint; gap matches the gutter.

tokens.name: columns-mobile
tokens.usage: Below 768px. Cards are full width; two-up only for small tiles.

tokens.name: columns-tablet
tokens.usage: 768px to 1023px. Two cards per row.

tokens.name: columns-desktop
tokens.usage: 1024px and up. Three or four cards per row.
